_readme: Style board: every style x every subject, same seed, no style anchor. Render with: node scripts/style-board.js scripts/asset-gen/boards/round1.json. Pick favourites by code (A, B, ...); the next round branches from them.
name: round1
title: Round 1: broad survey of rendering styles
framing: single subject centered, entire subject visible, plain flat light grey background
palette: warm golden saturated palette, early frontier era
negative: text, letters, watermark, signature, logo, border, frame, cropped, cut off, person, wearer, mannequin, hands, busy background, scenery, landscape, ground, environment, multiple separate objects, blurry, lowres, jpeg artifacts, deformed

subjects.label: Moss Shrimp
subjects.prompt: a plump curled freshwater shrimp with a soft green mossy shell, small claws, long thin antennae, subtly alien wildlife

subjects.label: Oak Logs
subjects.prompt: a small stack of three cut oak logs with rough bark and pale end-grain rings

subjects.label: Unity Scout Set
subjects.prompt: a lightweight scout outfit laid out as one set with no wearer: hooded travel cloak, quilted tunic, leather belts and pouches, woven sash with folk-pattern embroidery, natural dyed fabrics, humble communal earth-folk craftsmanship, no metal plating

styles.label: Painterly illustration
styles.prompt: visible brushstrokes, soft blended gradients, storybook concept art
styles.negative: photo, photorealistic, 3d render, vector, flat color

styles.label: Cel-shaded, bold ink
styles.prompt: thick black ink outlines, flat color fills, hard-edged cel shadows, graphic novel style
styles.negative: photo, photorealistic, 3d render, soft gradients, painterly

styles.label: Stylized 3D
styles.prompt: smooth sculpted forms, soft studio lighting, gentle ambient occlusion, toy-like readability
styles.negative: photo, photorealistic, flat, 2d, sketch, line art

styles.label: Pixel art
styles.prompt: crisp hard-edged pixels, limited palette, 16-bit era, no anti-aliasing, clean pixel outline
styles.negative: photo, photorealistic, 3d render, smooth gradients, blurry, painterly

styles.label: Watercolor and ink
styles.lead: watercolor and ink illustration game icon
styles.prompt: loose watercolor washes, delicate pen linework, soft bleeding edges, subtle paper texture
styles.negative: photo, photorealistic, 3d render, vector, hard cel shading

styles.label: Woodcut / linocut print
styles.prompt: carved bold lines, limited ink colors, folk printmaking texture, hand-printed look
styles.negative: photo, photorealistic, 3d render, smooth gradients, glossy

styles.label: Flat vector
styles.prompt: clean geometric shapes, minimal shading, crisp edges, simple bold forms
styles.negative: photo, photorealistic, 3d render, texture, brushstrokes, gradients

styles.label: Low-poly faceted
styles.prompt: flat-shaded triangular facets, gem-like geometric planes, simple lighting
styles.negative: photo, photorealistic, smooth surfaces, painterly, sketch

styles.label: Gouache folk art
styles.lead: matte gouache folk-art painting game icon
styles.prompt: rich flat opaque color, decorative folk ornament and patterns, naive charm, visible matte paint texture

styles.label: Engraved ink + tint
styles.prompt: fine cross-hatched engraving lines, antique field-guide plate, muted color tint over linework
styles.negative: photo, photorealistic, 3d render, flat vector, neon
